description: This skill grants perfect, unhurried clarity — while its bearer stands still and watches, the true nature of any threat, lie, or intention reveals itself in full, correct and complete. But the accuracy is never free: the moment that knowledge is acted upon, the cost of certainty falls not on the bearer, but on someone nearby, paid in a currency the skill alone decides.
soul_resonance: Kaelen calculated the safest way into the creek and was right, and his brother died anyway — this skill is the world's cruel agreement that his correctness was never the problem, only ever the price of it.
etching_text: It settled into him cold and slow, like creekwater rising past the ankles, past the knees, patient as judgment. Somewhere distant he heard a debt being written down in a hand that was not his own, and understood he would spend the rest of his life reading the ink.
